correctness.rationale: An exhaustive 1091-face matching complex has a certified 539-pair discrete-Morse matching, leaving exactly one 0-cell and twelve 3-cells; an exhaustive topological sort of all 3942 directed Hasse incidences proves acyclicity. The 48 graph automorphisms are enumerated by adjacency-preserving backtracking; the action on four Hamiltonian cycles has image S4 and kernel {1,z}, while the 18-edge permutation sign sends z to -1. Two independent character calculations, signed invariant-simplex traces and compatible edge-cycle inclusion–exclusion, agree on all 48 automorphisms. Each exactly matches the five-term irreducible decomposition, and its ten conjugacy classes have verified sizes. A separate simplicial GF2 boundary calculation independently reproduces the expected Betti numbers. Quotient homology follows from finite-group rational invariants after subdivision; no finite test is treated as an infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The canonical Franklin graph has a known non-equivariant twelve-sphere matching-complex homotopy type but previously unaccounted-for 48-element symmetry action. The exact full rational irreducible decomposition and ten-class character are natural missing invariants, revealing an 8+4 half-turn splitting and a genuinely different full-group versus index-two-subgroup quotient rational homology profile. The precise information is not determined by sphere multiplicities and matters for symmetry quotients and comparison with other symmetric cubic graphs. It is a finite but complete and motivated classification, not a routine normalization check or arbitrary small slice.
